description: Ninety-second supplemental quality-audit override batch for BetInsight provider eligibility – United States completed state-by-state across all 50 states plus District of Columbia.
qa_count_note: US is the final ISO-level jurisdiction in the 250-jurisdiction QA program. This batch preserves the required state-by-state model: 50 states plus District of Columbia are evaluated separately for online/mobile sports betting.

US.source_name: U.S. state gaming regulators / state lotteries
US.note_de: Sportwetten werden in den USA bundesstaatlich bzw. im District of Columbia geregelt. BetInsight gibt deshalb keine pauschale US-Anbieterliste aus. Nach Auswahl des Bundesstaats werden nur die für die jeweilige Region konservativ verifizierten Online-/Mobile-Sportsbooks angezeigt. Retail-only, tribal/on-premise-only und noch nicht gestartete Angebote werden nicht als statewide Online-Anbieter ausgegeben.
US.note_en: Sports betting in the United States is regulated state by state and in the District of Columbia. BetInsight therefore does not publish a single nationwide US provider list. After state selection, only conservatively verified online/mobile sportsbooks for that jurisdiction are shown. Retail-only, tribal/on-premise-only and not-yet-launched offers are not treated as statewide online providers.
